title: New Moon in Scorpio
tldr: A seed point for depth, trust, release, intimacy, shared resources, and honest transformation.
theme: Scorpio is a fixed water sign ruled traditionally by Mars. This New Moon begins work around depth, trust, release, intimacy, shared resources, and honest transformation.
shadow: control disguised as strength, testing people instead of telling the truth, or holding on until it hurts
integration: letting what is expired complete so real intimacy has room

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc shows where holding on too tightly pushes away what you want.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Begin with Scorpio; watch what the Taurus Full Moon reveals about balance, response, and integration.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Track this intention for six months, then revisit what matured at the same-sign Full Moon.

ritual.timing: Set intentions only after the exact New Moon. The strongest window is the first 8 hours; use up to about 60 hours after exact when needed. Do not use this protocol for eclipses.
ritual.materials: Mars kamea, red candle, bloodstone or garnet, basil, water, incense, and a symbol of release.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what you are calling in through Scorpio. Choose one small action that proves the intention has a place to land.

journalPrompt: Where am I ready to begin again through depth, trust, release, intimacy, shared resources, and honest transformation, without repeating the shadow of control disguised as strength, testing people instead of telling the truth, or holding on until it hurts?
tarotPrompt: What first action will help this Scorpio intention take form?
